subject: Is it possible to work with projected data in DeducerSpatial

messages.author: fdaa54d30ab7b913
messages.subject: Is it possible to work with projected data in DeducerSpatial
parts:
I am working with SpatialDeducer and I was able to load a projected shapefile by changing the "proj" argument.

Is it possible to copy and paste the parameters for the desired projection instead of writing it every time?

Also, how do I convert a data.frame that has the latitude and longitude projected (not decimal degrees)?

When I try to load a txt file with UTM values, I get the following error:

> sitiosCRTM05qgis_temp <- sitiosCRTM05qgis
> if (class(sitiosCRTM05qgis[, 'x']) == 'factor') {
+ sitiosCRTM05qgis_temp[,'x'] <- as.numeric(as.character(sitiosCRTM05qgis_temp[, 'x']))
+ }
> if (class(sitiosCRTM05qgis[, 'y']) == 'factor') {
+ sitiosCRTM05qgis_temp[,'y'] <- as.numeric(as.character(sitiosCRTM05qgis_temp[, 'y']))
+ }
> sitiosCRTM05qgis_temp <- subset(sitiosCRTM05qgis_temp,
+ !is.na(x)  & !is.na(y) )
> puntos <- SpatialPointsDataFrame(sitiosCRTM05qgis_temp[,c('x', 'y')], data=sitiosCRTM05qgis_temp,proj4string=CRS('+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84'))
Error en validityMethod(as(object, superClass)) :
  Geographical CRS given to non-conformant data:  500632.8451 1192979.4670
> puntos <- spTransform(puntos,osm())
Error en spTransform(puntos, osm()) :
  error in evaluating the argument 'x' in selecting a method for function 'spTransform': Error: objeto 'puntos' no encontrado
> rm(sitiosCRTM05qgis_temp)

Best,

Manuel

messages.subject: Re: Is it possible to work with projected data in DeducerSpatial
parts:
On Wed, Jul 4, 2012 at 7:44 PM, <mspin...@gmail.com> wrote:
> I am working with SpatialDeducer and I was able to load a projected
> shapefile by changing the "proj" argument.
>
> Is it possible to copy and paste the parameters for the desired projection
> instead of writing it every time?

currently you have to type the projection, but I hope to autodetect in
the future.

>
> Also, how do I convert a data.frame that has the latitude and longitude
> projected (not decimal degrees)?

The "Convert data.frame" dialog only supports conversion of longlat
coordinates. You will have to convert your data.frame using code.

>
> When I try to load a txt file with UTM values, I get the following error:
>
>> sitiosCRTM05qgis_temp <- sitiosCRTM05qgis
>> if (class(sitiosCRTM05qgis[, 'x']) == 'factor') {
> + sitiosCRTM05qgis_temp[,'x'] <-
> as.numeric(as.character(sitiosCRTM05qgis_temp[, 'x']))
> + }
>> if (class(sitiosCRTM05qgis[, 'y']) == 'factor') {
> + sitiosCRTM05qgis_temp[,'y'] <-
> as.numeric(as.character(sitiosCRTM05qgis_temp[, 'y']))
> + }
>> sitiosCRTM05qgis_temp <- subset(sitiosCRTM05qgis_temp,
> + !is.na(x) & !is.na(y) )
>> puntos <- SpatialPointsDataFrame(sitiosCRTM05qgis_temp[,c('x', 'y')],
>> data=sitiosCRTM05qgis_temp,proj4string=CRS('+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84'))
> Error en validityMethod(as(object, superClass)) :
> Geographical CRS given to non-conformant data: 500632.8451 1192979.4670
>> puntos <- spTransform(puntos,osm())
> Error en spTransform(puntos, osm()) :
> error in evaluating the argument 'x' in selecting a method for function
> 'spTransform': Error: objeto 'puntos' no encontrado
>> rm(sitiosCRTM05qgis_temp)
>
> Best,
>
> Manuel
